records.question: 查询我在《数据库原理及安全》这门课的成绩，包括课程名称和分数，按课程名称排序。
records.reference_sql: SELECT c.course_name, g.score FROM academic.grades AS g JOIN academic.course_offerings AS o ON o.offering_id = g.offering_id JOIN academic.courses AS c ON c.course_id = o.course_id WHERE g.student_id = 'S01' AND c.course_id = 'C01' ORDER BY c.course_name
records.review_note: 必须限定 S01 和课程 C01，并通过 offering_id 关联课程名称与成绩。
